metric_note: SpliceSeq reports event PSI only; the 1C/1D choice is an alternative terminal exon (plus strand: 1C ends at chr22:45 563 362, 1D continues into an 829-nt terminal exon at chr22:45 600 307-45 601 135), so AT PSI is a proxy, not the 1C:1D ratio
caveats: PAAD (4) and ESCA (13) have too few normals for a paired design
CAF fractions are relative (no immune reference), so cross-cancer comparisons are rank-based only
SpliceSeq PSI is precomputed by its own pipeline; it is not reproducible from open junction files in this project
